purpose: Rarity budgets authored design systems and coordination, not decorative noise.

Common.intent: One clear, attractive visual idea with quiet support from construction.

Uncommon.intent: One dominant design system plus one subordinate support system.

Rare.intent: A strong focal composition with two quieter, direction-aware supporting systems.

globalRules: A higher rarity may coordinate more systems but may not give them equal visual weight.
One system must remain primary; supports must occupy fewer cells or lower-contrast roles.
No garment may activate motif, trim, pattern, and color block simultaneously in V3.
Surface budgets count renderer-visible cells, not semantic labels.
A Rare fails if its design signature matches a Common after surface systems are removed.
